## Expanded Agentic Ecosystem: Claude Desktop MCP Connector


Florencia Paredes


October 15, 2026


Bring Rescale engineering capabilities and context into Claude Desktop with the Rescale MCP connector. OAuth2 makes access simple: users sign in with their Rescale account, then ask Claude to find jobs, review logs and results, identify available analyses or hardware, and prepare the next step in a simulation workflow without leaving the conversation.


[Get started](https://rescale.com/documentation/mcp-server-getting-started/) connecting Rescale to Claude Desktop and see a demo of how it works below.
